question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Reliable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Trusted**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Reliable **means a person or a thing that you can trust.

 
 
• Example -* Japanese cars are usually very **reliable**.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Trusted **means reliable, responsible, and can be trusted completely.
 
 
• Example -* I **trusted **you with everything I had.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Reliable**' and '**Trusted**' are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Wealthy **means having great wealth; rich,
 
• **Fortunate **means having good luck.
 
• **Intelligent **means having a good amount of mental ability.
